newsitem.title: UK: GKN up on NatWest note, upbeat auto report.
newsitem.headline: GKN up on NatWest note, upbeat auto report.

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc recovered from recent weakness on Thursday as the company was rated "add" in a review of the engineering sector by NatWest Securities and after a report of soaring UK car production.
GKN shares were up 6-1/2p at 10.87-1.2 stg by 1107 GMT, after on November 18 closing at their lowest level in three months.
Other automotive parts companies were also firm in a generally weak market, with LucasVarity Plc up 1p at 239 and T&N Plc up 2p at 134.
Analysts at NatWest were not immediately available for comment.
The Office of National Statistics said on Wednesday UK car production rose to 179,963 in October, 39 percent higher than a year before.
